name: yf_market_summary
description:
Latest levels of major US market gauges from Yahoo Finance: S&P 500 (^GSPC), Dow Jones (^DJI), NASDAQ (^IXIC), Russell 2000 (^RUT), VIX (^VIX) and the 10-year Treasury yield index (^TNX). Takes no inputs.
Returns: {market_summary: [{index, symbol, price}]}; only the last value, no change.
History for one index: yf_index_history; sector ETFs: yf_sector_performance. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {}
